overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows that husband-wife relationship dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,768 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,676 views) massively outperform general heartbreak poetry, broad emotional quotes, and specific family member niches.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on marital unspoken tensions or partner understanding achieved the highest views (1.7k+ vs <400 for others).
winning_patterns.action: Double down on mature relationship dynamics, compromise, and post-marriage emotional distance.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed as a direct questioning of everyday life situations ('Shaadi Ke Baad...', 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala...') yield higher engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Continue opening with relatable relational interrogations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained only 20 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or generic sad quotes. Ground the content in realistic, observable relationship friction.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister-focused videos (jfmMztnam_A, fAAoIQCRMXU) had low traction compared to parental or spousal topics.
weak_patterns.action: Shift focus away from siblings and prioritize spousal or core self-reflection themes.

next_video.hook_style: Direct observation about silent treatment in marriage
next_video.concept: A couple sitting in complete silence in the living room, scrolling phones, remembering when silence used to feel comfortable instead of heavy.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the observation: 'अब झगड़े नहीं होते घर में… खामोशी ज्यादा शोर मचाती है।'
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that the silence isn't due to anger, but because they have stopped expecting the other to understand.
next_video.reason: Leverages the proven high-performing husband-wife relationship topic while capitalizing on evening peak hours for emotional content consumption.

experiment: Testing if adding a subtle regret angle to high-performing marital dynamics increases comment interactions, which have historically been low.
